handover_note.known: Property: 42 Brackenveil Row, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ. Tenant (Elowen Marr) reported peeling kitchen laminate with sharp edges that caused cuts, and doors that do not close; two dogs need securing before any visit (events 1, 10). Landlord approval is recorded only for the original laminate-repair scope (event 6). The landlord then asked for up-to-date estimates for a full kitchen and for cupboards and doors only (event 16). That request is not approval of either option (events 13, 16, 26). The contractor (Kellan Rook, Alderline Joinery) sent full-kitchen figures on 24 Sep (event 24): supply £4,850 + VAT, removal and fitting including splashback £3,800 + VAT, waste removal £230 + VAT, electrical estimate £380 + VAT still to be checked. The figures were forwarded to the landlord (event 25), and a landlord reply is awaited (event 26).
handover_note.conflicts: 1) The contractor raised a 15% commission, asked whether the old or revised basis and any cap applied, and how VAT affects the total (event 22). Nia told him to use the previous arrangement (event 23), but no calculation, cap, VAT treatment or total payable was settled (events 22, 23, 25). The figures sent to the landlord may therefore change. 2) The contractor said earlier he had quoted a full kitchen (event 12), but never supplied that quote. 3) The contractor says the doors are beyond repair (events 12, 14), but there has been no site visit or written assessment. The only approved scope is a laminate repair. 4) The cupboards-and-doors-only estimate the landlord asked for has not arrived (events 24, 25).
handover_note.done: Nothing further sent in this step. History: the landlord was asked and the contractor assigned (events 3, 7). Tenant availability of 16/17/18 Sep, 11:00-14:00, was passed to the contractor (events 10, 11), but no visit was booked and the first date has passed (event 21). The two estimates were requested from the contractor (event 18) and the figures were forwarded to the landlord (event 25).
handover_note.needed: Please decide and confirm the commission basis, any cap and VAT treatment, so a firm total payable can be given to the landlord. Then either correct the figures already sent or confirm them to the landlord. Please also get the contractor to supply the cupboards-and-doors-only estimate and book a site visit, using the tenant's dog-access arrangements, to assess the actual damage. Do not instruct replacement work without explicit landlord approval. Consider an interim fix or safety advice for the sharp edges, since the tenant has been cut. The landlord has been away or reachable only through his office (event 15), so please also confirm the best contact route.
